origin.label: About TODA
origin.headline: By tattoo artists. For tattoo artists.
origin.line1: Dana comes home. Exhausted, frustrated, 40 unread messages. The same chaos as every day.
origin.line2: Tomek researched all day. For a whole industry — almost no solution.
origin.bubble1: Hey, could you just build me a booking calendar?
origin.bubble2: Come home. I've got something much better.
origin.closing: The first day of TODA. TODA stands for Tomek and Dana.

features.label: Features
features.headline: Everything your studio needs.
features.feature1Excerpt: Motif, size, placement, references — all at once. No back-and-forth.
features.feature2Excerpt: You set your hours, your client books themselves. Double bookings are impossible.
features.feature3Title: Your web presence. Ready in minutes.
features.feature3Excerpt: Upload images, update info, go live. You do it yourself — no web designer, no prior knowledge needed.
features.feature4Excerpt: Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, bio link — wherever your client finds you, just send your link. The request always lands in TODA.
features.feature5Excerpt: One click, one short message — your client gets a new booking link straight to their inbox. No back-and-forth.
features.feature6Excerpt: All appointments, all requests — instantly accessible. You always know what your week looks like.

testimonials.label: Voices from the community
testimonials.headline: What our customers say.
testimonials.quote1: My requests come in organised now. No WhatsApp chaos, no missing references. I know immediately whether a request is worth taking.
testimonials.quote2: I used to spend whole evenings just on messages. Now I check in once and I'm done.
testimonials.quote3: Clients already know what to expect before the first conversation. It saves more time than I thought.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Frequently asked questions.
faq.q1: Do I need my own website?
faq.a1: No. TODA is your booking page. One link — and clients see your gallery, your info, and can request directly. No developer, no hosting.
faq.q2: What if a client does not show up?
faq.a2: Deposit handling is our next feature release. For now, the structured intake form already helps: clients who are serious enough to fill it out tend to show up.
faq.q3: Can I use TODA on my phone?
faq.a3: Yes. TODA runs as a web app on iPhone, Android, iPad, and desktop. No app install needed.
faq.a4: A few minutes. Set up your profile, set your working hours, share your link. Done.
faq.a5: Yes. No contract, no minimum term. Cancel any time — with one click in settings.
